title: Bandai ban list change is live today: new Banned Pair
detail: Official notice (effective 27 Nov): Jewelry Bonney (EB05-001) can no longer share a deck with Luffy (OP13-001) or Trafalgar Law (OP01-002); alt arts included. The page names no individually banned or restricted cards and does not name any cards removed from the list. Watch Bonney and Law prices.

title: Aura Seeker (ME7) is out in Japan today, but not yet confirmed by an official page
detail: Mega Lucario Z ex is the headliner; the set is listed at 78 cards. The 27 Nov date still rests on a May Pokébeach report, and no post-release pull rates or prices were found yet. Pull rates are unconfirmed; expect launch prices to overshoot and then settle within weeks.

title: Tomorrow, Sat 28 Nov: Regionals in Stuttgart and Alicante
detail: Still upcoming. Limitless has no new Pokémon results since Chiba (22 Nov), so nothing new to report on finished events.

title: Réunion shops: nothing new
detail: Miyata Kard Market shows no OP-18 or Aura Seeker listing (only an OP18 guide article dated 20 Nov); Coffret Dresseur d'Élite 30e Anniversaire is sold out there. Sortilèges' site returned an error, so it was not checked. No price-mover check was possible today (collection file has no TCGdex ids), so none reported.
